rule.name: DepthOnlyWorklist
rule.message: This worklist loop is bounded only by a depth limit and remembers nothing it has expanded. A depth limit bounds how long one path is, not how many paths there are: when items share children (a graph, not a tree), each item is expanded once per path that reaches it, so the work grows as the fan-out to the power of the depth and can run out of memory. Keep a Set of the items already expanded and skip an item that is in it (if (!expanded.add(item)) continue).

property.name: xpath
property.value: let $takes := ('poll', 'pop', 'removeFirst', 'removeLast', 'pollFirst', 'pollLast', 'remove'), $appends := ('add', 'push', 'offer', 'addLast', 'addFirst', 'offerLast', 'offerFirst', 'addAll'), $nesting := ('ForeachStatement', 'ForStatement', 'WhileStatement', 'DoStatement', 'LambdaExpression'), $depthName := 'depth|level|hops|distance' return //WhileStatement [let $loop := ., $work := (.//MethodCall[@MethodName = $takes][ArgumentList/@Size = 0] /*[1][self::VariableAccess or self::FieldAccess]/@Name)[1], $adds := .//MethodCall[@MethodName = $appends][*[1][self::VariableAccess or self::FieldAccess][@Name = $work]] return exists($work) and (count($adds) > 1 or exists($adds[@MethodName = 'addAll']) or (some $add in $adds satisfies exists($add/ancestor::*[local-name() = $nesting][. >> $loop]))) and exists(.//InfixExpression[@Operator = ('<', '<=', '>', '>=')] [*[self::VariableAccess][matches(@Name, $depthName, 'i')] [@Name = $loop//LocalVariableDeclaration/VariableDeclarator/VariableId/@Name] or *[self::FieldAccess][matches(@Name, $depthName, 'i')] or *[self::MethodCall][matches(@MethodName, $depthName, 'i')]]) and not(.//MethodCall[@MethodName = ('contains', 'containsKey', 'putIfAbsent', 'computeIfAbsent')] [not(*[1][self::VariableAccess or self::FieldAccess][@Name = $work])]) and not(.//MethodCall[@MethodName = ('add', 'put')] [*[1][pmd-java:typeIs('java.util.Set') or pmd-java:typeIs('java.util.Map')]] [not(*[1][self::VariableAccess or self::FieldAccess][@Name = $work])]) and not(.//AssignmentExpression[*[1][self::FieldAccess]][*[2][self::BooleanLiteral][@True = true()]]) and not($adds//MethodCall[@MethodName = ('getChildren', 'getChildNodes', 'children', 'getChild')] | $adds/ancestor::ForeachStatement[. >> $loop]/*[2] /descendant-or-self::MethodCall[@MethodName = ('getChildren', 'getChildNodes', 'children')] | $adds//FieldAccess[@Name = 'children'])]
